title: A warning is pending before Valid From; an alert first seen just after its end alerts only within the grace window; the active cap ends a long validity
notes: WARPX1 serial 200 is synthetic. Its 5-day validity exceeds the 96-hour active cap.
ALTK07 219 ended at 18:00 and was issued at 17:58, so at 18:00:30 it is inside the 300-second grace window. ALTK06 727 ended at the same time but was issued at 17:18, so it never alerts.
